name: Zoho Campaigns
description: Zoho Campaigns is an AI-powered email, SMS, and WhatsApp marketing platform that helps small businesses build campaigns, automate customer journeys, and track performance across channels from one place.
best_for: Small businesses wanting affordable, contact-tier-priced email marketing with built-in SMS and WhatsApp channels and deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
features: Zia AI assistant for drafting campaign copy, refining tone, and personalizing sends
Unified email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaign creation from one platform
240+ ready-to-use, mobile-first responsive email templates with a drag-and-drop editor
Marketing automation workflows with live in-flight editing and Trace Contact Path drop-off analysis
Real-time analytics for opens, clicks, and deliveries across all channels
55+ integrations including Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Shopify, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zapier
Advanced segmentation, dynamic content, and send-time optimization on the Professional plan
Native mobile apps for iOS and Android

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 2,000 contacts, 6,000 emails/month, 5 users, drag-and-drop templates with generative AI, and 35+ app integrations.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Starts at 500 contacts, billed annually ($4/month billed monthly). Unlimited emails, 10 users, 120+ templates, A/B testing, and basic automation workflows. Price rises with contact-list size, up to 100,000 contacts.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Starts at 500 contacts, billed annually ($6/month billed monthly). Adds advanced segmentation, dynamic content, send-time optimization, abandoned-cart workflows, and webhooks. Price rises with contact-list size.

pros: Contact-tier pricing starts at just $3/month for 500 contacts billed annually, among the cheapest entry points in email marketing
Native SMS and WhatsApp channels alongside email in one workflow, not a bolted-on add-on
Deep native integration with Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, and the wider Zoho suite
cons: Pricing is contact-tiered and rises with list size like most email marketing competitors, not a flat rate
Ecommerce automations like abandoned-cart and purchase-follow-up workflows are gated to the Professional plan, not included in Standard
Best value comes from being inside or willing to adopt the wider Zoho ecosystem

faq.question: Does Zoho Campaigns have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes — Zoho Campaigns' Forever Free plan covers up to 2,000 contacts and 6,000 emails per month, with 5 user seats, drag-and-drop templates, generative AI, and 35+ app integrations, with no credit card required.

faq.question: How does Zoho Campaigns pricing work?
faq.answer: Paid plans are priced by contact-list size rather than a flat fee. At the smallest tier (up to 500 contacts), Standard starts at $3/month and Professional at $4.50/month, both billed annually (higher if billed monthly); larger contact tiers cost more, scaling up to 500,000+ contacts on request.

alternatives.name: GetResponse
alternatives.description: An email marketing platform with automation, landing pages, webinars, ecommerce marketing, and lead-generation tools.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting email marketing plus webinars and broader lead-generation tools

alternatives.name: MailerLite
alternatives.description: An email marketing platform for creating campaigns, automations, landing pages, signup forms, websites, and digital products, with subscriber-based plans and a permanent free tier.
alternatives.best_for: Creators and small businesses wanting email campaigns bundled with lightweight website and landing-page tools

alternatives.name: Omnisend
alternatives.description: An ecommerce-focused email and SMS marketing platform with pre-built automation workflows for cart abandonment, order confirmation, and customer win-back.
alternatives.best_for: Ecommerce stores wanting pre-built email and SMS automation tied directly to sales events
strengths: Email plus SMS in one platform

alternatives.name: Constant Contact
alternatives.description: An email marketing platform with campaign templates, automation, event marketing, and social media posting tools built for small businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses and nonprofits wanting an established, support-heavy email marketing platform
